phase.name: Refeed — Bali
phase._note: Tracked refeed, not an untracked maintenance block. TARGET REVISED 5 Sep 2026 from 76.5 to 75.0 kg. Mathew's own words: 76.5 was "a figure I plucked out of the air as it seemed like it'd be about right for a glycogen rebound", not a goal, and "if I go to Bali at 75 that'd be absolutely fine". THE WEIGHT NUMBER IS NOT THE SUCCESS CRITERION for this phase — the criterion is subjective recovery (feeling good, out of a deficit, hormonal recovery before the 12 Sep flight) plus waist holding at 95–96 cm. As of 5 Sep Mathew reports feeling considerably better, so the phase has ALREADY PASSED on the criterion that matters, at 74.4 kg. Do not let a future session quietly convert 75.0 back into a performance target, and do not recommend force-feeding carbohydrate to reach it: he explicitly does not want to "start eating tonnes of clean carbs for no real reason", and he is right that the lever for hormonal recovery is removing the energy deficit, not filling glycogen. 75.0 was chosen because it is +0.6 kg from 74.4, comfortably inside the plausible glycogen-and-bound-water headroom of roughly +0.5–1.5 kg, so it is reachable at Week 2's maintenance target without adding fat and without changing behaviour. The superseded 76.5 would have needed a surplus he does not want; see rebound_diagnosis_note in current-estimates.json for why it was never compatible with the plan's own Week 1 deficit. Goal weight here is glycogen and bound water (~3g per gram of glycogen), not tissue — so tracking_mode is "balance": intake is tracked against the ramp target and weight is NEVER projected from calorie balance, because the two are decoupled here. Waist is the real check: 95 cm at Phase 2 close (27 Aug), still 95 cm on 3 Sep. If waist holds at 95–97 cm while the scale rises, the rebound is doing what it should; if waist rises with it, that is fat, which becomes the likely explanation above about 76.5 kg since glycogen cannot account for more than ~1.5 kg from here. carryover_start_date was set to 2026-08-31 to skip the 29–30 Aug part week; removed on 1 Sep 2026 because that was wrong on two counts. The field exists to skip the glycogen-and-water noise of a cut's first week, which is not what a 2-day refeed weekend is, and the carryover maths already costs part weeks correctly — it scored those 2 days against a pro-rated target of 100, not the full 1,500. Excluding them discarded real data to solve a problem that did not exist, and contradicted the Phase 1 precedent where the date was moved *earlier* (20 Apr → 13 Apr) to capture the phase from day one. With no carryover_start_date the code falls back to start_date, so the field cannot drift if the phase is ever re-dated again — as this one already was, from 1 Sep to 29 Aug. Scored value for 29–30 Aug: −90 kcal.
phase.start_date_note: Set to 29 Aug (Sat), not 28 Aug: Friday 28 Aug was the last day of the cut, and its ramen cheat and walks belong to Phase 2, not here. start_kg 74.8 is the cut's close weight (27 Aug reading carried forward through 28 Aug) and so predates start_date by a day — same handover convention as 6 Jul. This also makes the two meal-plan stages exactly 7 days each: 29 Aug–4 Sep and 5–11 Sep.

ramp.how: One to two carb portions per day — 50g dry rice or oats plus a banana at breakfast, building to bread or a jacket potato with meals. Weekend days take the larger share.
Full maintenance. Eat normally — Gousto plus carb sides, no restriction.

phase.ramp_note: Re-dated from the original Sep 1–11 plan in docs/health-conversation-snapshot.md, then collapsed on 29 Aug from three date steps (1,750 → 2,000 → 2,200) into the two meal_plan stages, so the ramp and the stages can no longer disagree. The progression is now weekday-to-weekday, 1,800 → 2,100, with weekends +350 above the weekday figure in both weeks. Weekly totals: Week 1 13,300 (vs 13,250 on the three-step version, +50), Week 2 exactly 15,400. Friday 28 Aug’s ramen + chocolate (~1,075 kcal, a 1,858 kcal day) was the cut's last meal, not the refeed's first — it sits in Phase 2.

totals._note: avg = (weekday×5 + weekend×2) / 7 = (1480×5 + 1509×2) / 7 = 10,418 / 7 = 1,488. Weekday breakfast swapped from the Double Shake (232 kcal) to Overnight Oats on 29 Aug, applied to all weekdays in both stages. The bowl has been cut twice since: peanut butter 20g → 10g on 30 Aug (552 → 517), then halved outright on 1 Sep (517 → 289) because the full bowl was unpalatable — Mathew managed only half of it on 31 Aug and found that hard work. The halved build keeps the full whey scoop and cuts the bulk (oats 70g → 35g, Fage 75g → 40g, Oatly dropped, water instead), which preserves 31 of the 43g protein for 289 of the 517 kcal. Weekday is now 1,423 − 232 + 289 = 1,480, protein 144g — below the 150g target, accepted. That is 320 short of the 1,800 Week 1 weekday target and 620 short of the 2,100 Week 2 weekday target, and Mathew chose on 1 Sep NOT to replace those calories in the plan, intending to fill the gap with tracked additions day by day instead. Weekend items are still the Phase 2 cut brunch (1,509) against targets of 2,150 / 2,450, so the weekend additions have NOT been agreed yet and the Meal Plan screen will show an “Items short” pill. The numbers the app uses for the weekly card come from stages[].target_kcal_weekday / target_kcal_weekend.

stages.label: Week 1
stages._note: Ramp week, 7 days. Weekends run +350 kcal/day above weekdays, matching Week 2. Weekly total 1,800×5 + 2,150×2 = 13,300, average 1,900 — 7 kcal/day above the original ramp average of 1,893, i.e. nothing. Daily deltas vs 2,200 maintenance: +400 weekday, +50 weekend, so a 2,100 kcal weekly deficit (5×400 + 2×50). Round numbers chosen deliberately over the exact-1,893 alternative (1,793 / 2,143). Supersedes the ramp's original day-by-day steps: with the weekend uplift, Sat 29–Sun 30 are the week's highest days at 2,150 rather than its lowest at 1,750. Weekday items settled 29 Aug: the Double Shake became Overnight Oats, taking the weekday base to 1,743; the powdered peanut butter was cut 20g → 10g on 30 Aug (1,708), and the whole bowl was halved on 1 Sep for palatability, leaving 1,480 — 320 short of 1,800, deliberately accepted rather than padded, and to be covered by tracked additions rather than plan items. Weekday carbs fall to ~160g, well below the 200–250g band, which is the real cost since the rebound is carb-driven rather than energy-driven. Weekend items still TBD: needs +641 kcal/day over the cut brunch (1,509) to reach 2,150, and until they're added the screen flags the gap. Weekdays and weekend now contribute comparably to the week's 2,882 kcal shortfall — 1,600 (56%) from the five weekdays, 1,282 (44%) from the two weekend days — so the weekend is no longer the single binding constraint it was at the 1,708 base.

stages.label: Week 2
stages._note: Full maintenance, ~280–300g carbs. Weekends run +350 kcal/day above weekdays. Weekly total 2,100×5 + 2,450×2 = 10,500 + 4,900 = 15,400, average exactly 2,200. Daily deltas vs maintenance: +100 weekday, −250 weekend, so the week lands on exactly 0 — true energy balance, which is the point of a balance phase. Mathew's own figures, agreed 29 Aug; they supersede the earlier 2,129 / 2,379, which carried a 3 kcal rounding residue. Meal items TBD — the weekday base is 1,480 after the 1 Sep halving of the Overnight Oats, so Week 2 still needs +620 kcal/day on weekdays and +941 at weekends (weekend base 1,509), a 4,982 kcal weekly gap. This is the week that matters: Bali is 12 Sep, so there is no third week to make it up in. Weekend protein is the weak spot at 124g vs the 150g target: the weekend shake is a single scoop, and making it a double adds 148 kcal and 21g protein.

meal_plan.weekly_energy_target_note: Signed: positive = deficit, negative = surplus, 0 = hold at maintenance. A refeed targets energy balance over a full week, so 0. Unused while the stages declare target_kcal_weekday / target_kcal_weekend, which the app prefers because they survive a mid-week stage boundary; kept as a statement of intent and as the fallback for dates outside every stage. Set this negative for a bulk (e.g. -2100 for a ~300 kcal/day surplus).

recommendations.title: Book Post-Bali Blood Test
recommendations.detail: Target Mon 12–Fri 16 Oct 2026, ideally 08:00–09:00 after 14–19 days back from Bali and settled at maintenance. Fast 10–12 hours; water is fine. Avoid alcohol for 48–72 hours and strenuous training for 24–48 hours. Test lipids including ApoB, fasting glucose + insulin + HbA1c, testosterone + SHBG + LH/FSH + prolactin, vitamin D, liver, kidney, full blood count, uric acid and hsCRP.

recommendations.title: Squat & Deadlift — Phase 2 Protocol
recommendations.detail: Goal: muscle retention, not PRs. No 1RM testing for 8 weeks. Deadlift: 10×60 → 5×80 → 3×5×100 kg. Squat: 10×50 → 5×60 → 3×5×65–70 kg. Target RPE 8 on working sets — rep 5 should feel like 1–2 reps left. Autoregulate each week: if it's grinding, drop 5 kg and add a set. Extend squat warm-up from week 5 onward.

planned.title: DEXA Scan
planned.detail: Baseline body composition — fat %, lean mass, visceral fat, bone density, BMR. Nearest dedicated clinic: DexaStrong in Leeds (~45 min via M1 from Archer Lane). Ideal timing: once current fat loss phase ends, to get a clean post-cut baseline.
